like many others who have shared their reviews of this practice - we have had a shocking experience with the receptionist of this clinic. Today, my husband tried to drop off a stool sample for our 5 yr old daughter who has been very ill for 4 days. Unbeknown to us - the walk in clinic we took her to on Saturday was in a different borough to phoenix and so while they had advised us that her notes would be updated and we could simply drop off the sample, it turns out the notes were in the post. Rather than trying to understand the situation or show any empathy, the receptionist was dismissive, told him she could do nothing and basically told him to leave and fill out a form. Despite the rudeness, when he told me what had happened I filled out the form and returned to the clinic two hours later and unfortunately was met by the same receptionist who also cut me off mid sentence and told me she couldn’t take the sample and repeated her stock response of fill in a form. I politely told her I understood but that I had filled in said form. She told me to leave and wait till the doctor responded. I explained that I had a sick daughter at home and a full time job so going backwards and forwards was unhelpful. Begrudgingly She checked the system for me and found the doctor has responded - she then proceeded to berate me for not having told her about the response from the doctor. When I advised I hadn’t received a text she said - exact words-  ‘well I’m not a mind reader’.  When I asked her to not be so rude she offered to get her manager which I gladly accepted. She then launched a verbal tyrade about the problems I was causing, stormed out of reception, brought her manager back and proceeded to tell her, loudly, infront of other patients that I had demanded she take my daughters stool sample. I calmly explained to her manager what had actually transpired and her manager apologised for her behaviour. While the manager was very respectful and helpful, the situation was clearly not a surprise to her and now having read the other reviews I can see why. Perhaps she was having a bad day, perhaps she is having many bad days but I do not understand why anyone would do that job who possesses not an ounce of helpfulness or compassion.

To the managers of the practice, I will raise this formally with you - although it seems you have done nothing with the previous feedback.

To prospective patients, if you would like to be shown any level of respect at a time when you probably need it the most, do not waste your time here. There are plenty more clinics that understand the care in
